svg.title: BigQuery REST Execution Boundary
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for exposed-bigquery showing Exposed DSL entrypoints, local H2 SQL generation, BigQuery REST query jobs, result conversion, and the no-JDBC transaction boundary.
svg.text: Exposed builds SQL locally; BigQuery executes REST query jobs without JDBC transaction semantics.
Reader contract: exposed-bigquery is a REST query-job executor for Exposed-generated SQL, not a JDBC ORM or rollback-capable transaction layer.
